description: Track your bike's service history, documents, and insurance with ease.
_comment_background: SPLASH IS ICON-ORANGE BY CHOICE. background_color and theme_color are #E35D01 and the icon tiles were recolored to the same #E35D01, so the splash is one unbroken orange field with the logo sitting in it. (#E35D01 was picked over the original tile orange #FB6900; both icons were remapped black-to-#E35D01 preserving anti-aliasing and the 192's transparent corners.) One visible seam remains: when the splash hands over to the app, the screen goes from orange to the near-black app, and the status bar drops to the #3d1908 the theme-color meta in index.html carries. That flash is the price of an orange splash over a dark app. Do not 'fix' these back to dark to match the app — that reintroduces the clash this change removes.
